response.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY mt.Name) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS simple_avg_of_media_type_avgs FROM per_media;

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass the cutoff' means Bytes is greater than or equal to 10,323,804 (inclusive). Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded automatically by the comparison.

Media types are grouped by MediaType.Name, and each media type's average is the unweighted mean of its tracks' per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios. Tracks with Milliseconds <= 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero; the schema has no such rows that I can see, so this guard is likely a no-op.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Pass the cutoff' means strictly larger than 10,323,804 bytes (exclusive).
